neighbours.label: the piece that completes a compound starting with 'fish': strongest by far on 'ye' in fisheye (lens/projection), weaker on fish·bowl, fish·nets, fish·meal, Fish·bed; not the word 'fish' alone nor other '-eye' compounds
fire: The skate video was filmed entirely with a fisheye lens.
The dome camera produces a round fisheye image of the whole sky.
She bought a cheap fisheye adapter for her phone camera.
The software can correct fisheye distortion in panoramas.
Living in the palace felt like living in a fishbowl.
The dancers wore fishnets and feathered hats.
Trout farms depend on fishmeal imported from Peru.
The peephole has a small fisheye glass set in the door.
quiet: The skate video was filmed entirely with a telephoto lens.
The dome camera produces a round image of the whole sky.
She bought a cheap tripod adapter for her phone camera.
The software can correct red-eye in portraits.
Living in the palace felt like living in a birdcage.
The dancers ate fish and chips after the show.
Trout farms depend on grain imported from Peru.
The storm had a clear eye, and the needle has a small eye too.

notes: Card: 'ye' in Fisheye 17–18, then Fishbed, Fishbowls, fishnets, FishWatch, fishmeal at 6–9 (max 18.4). Probes: fisheye 0.96, fishmeal 0.34, fishnets 0.33, fishbowl 0.26, fishmonger 0.22; bullseye 0.01, wide-angle lens 0.00, 'fish swam' 0.08.
